info.title: ATHAR OS (أثر)
info.description: ATHAR — agentic travel guide for Algeria. Discover POIs, stays, experiences and artisans; plan trips; route with real transit schedules across all 69 wilayas.

get.description: Platform totals (POIs, stays, experiences, events, users, trips) plus POI distribution per wilaya and per category.
Paginated user listing for admins, filtered by role and verification status.

put.description: Change a user's role. Auto-creates a provider profile when promoting to a provider role, and deletes it when demoting.
Flip a user's is_verified flag (trust badge).

get.description: Paginated provider profiles for admins, filtered by verification status and provider type.

put.description: Mark a provider profile as verified.

delete.description: Admin moderation: delete an experience regardless of owner. Removes it from the Qdrant index.

get.description: Run an LLM-based (or rule-based dry-run fallback) quality verification on a POI, reporting a score out of 5, issue count, and missing fields.
Aggregate POI data quality: totals, and counts with phone, website, opening hours, or short descriptions.
Agent monitoring: totals, success/failure rates, token usage, average duration, and recent traces (P1 monitoring).

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Number of recent traces to return
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Number of recent traces to return

post.description: Ask the general travel assistant any Algeria travel question. Supports multi-turn memory via session_id. Rate limited to 20/hour; returns 503 when the LLM backend is not configured.
Structured itinerary planner: destination + duration + budget + interests produce a day-by-day plan. Rate limited to 10/hour.
Agent-driven search across POIs, stays, and experiences. Rate limited to 30/hour.
Ask about routes, schedules, or operator contacts. Rate limited to 20/hour.
Ask about festivals and cultural activities in a wilaya. Rate limited to 20/hour.

get.description: List the user's agent conversation sessions. Rate limited to 30/hour.

delete.description: Soft-delete a session and its memories. Owner only. Rate limited to 20/hour.

post.description: Register a craft workshop. A user can have at most one artisan profile; creating one auto-promotes a traveler account to the artisan role.

409.description: You already have an artisan profile

get.description: Paginated artisans filtered by wilaya, craft type, visitor acceptance, and name search. Sort by name, newest, or years of experience.
Artisan detail. Public.

put.description: Update an artisan profile. Only the owner or an admin can edit.

403.description: You can only edit your own artisan profile

delete.description: Delete an artisan profile. Only the owner or an admin can delete.

403.description: You can only delete your own artisan profile

get.description: Liveness + database connectivity probe. Returns 'ok' or 'degraded' with per-service status and latency.

post.description: Request a 6-digit OTP for passwordless login. When Twilio is configured the code is delivered by SMS; otherwise it is generated in-memory (never returned in the response). Rate limited to 10/minute globally and 3 sends per phone per 10 minutes.

400.description: Too many OTP requests for this number (per-phone throttling)

post.description: Exchange a phone + OTP for an access token and refresh token. Creates the user account on first login. A code is invalidated after 5 failed attempts (constant-time comparison). The refresh token is stored hashed with a rotation family.

400.description: Invalid or expired OTP, or too many attempts — request a new code

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a fresh access/refresh pair. Rotation is one-time-use: presenting an already-revoked token revokes the entire token family (stolen-token detection).

401.description: Invalid, expired, or revoked refresh token

post.description: Upgrade the authenticated user's account to a provider (guide/agency/hotel) and create their provider profile. Only users with the `traveler` role (or admins) can register; rate limited to 5/minute.

get.description: Every wilaya with aggregate stats: POI/featured/experience/stay/artisan counts, top categories, highlight POI + photo, and coordinates.
All content for a wilaya in one payload: POIs (alphabetical), active experiences (with provider info), active stays (by price), and artisans.

Editorial per-wilaya guide: featured POIs first, then top N per category ordered by combined score, each with transport access info (nearest station, distance, walking time, nearby modes). Includes active experiences and stays.
Active experiences in the POI's wilaya whose title/description mentions the POI (falls back to all wilaya experiences).

schema.title: Response Get Discover Experiences By Poi Poi Id

get.description: Paginated events/festivals calendar filtered by wilaya, category, and month (1-12). Public.

post.description: Add an event/festival to the calendar. Requires provider or admin role; the wilaya must exist.

get.description: Event detail. Public.

patch.description: Partial update of an event (provider or admin role).

delete.description: Delete an event (provider or admin role).

post.description: Add a new POI (requires provider or admin role). Wilaya must exist; the POI is immediately indexed for vector search.

get.description: Paginated POI listing with filters: wilaya, category, neighborhood (substring), name/description search, and sort (name or created_at).

post.description: Upload an image (JPEG/PNG/WebP, magic-byte validated) to MinIO and set it as the POI's primary photo. Requires provider or admin role.

get.description: Distinct POI neighborhoods, optionally filtered by wilaya.
POIs within a radius of a lat/lng point, sorted by distance. Optionally filtered by category. Results include distance_km.

Vector search over the Qdrant index, falling back to PostgreSQL full-text (French) when Qdrant is unavailable or returns nothing. Named POIs are ranked before placeholder names like 'Ruins (non nommé)'.
Full POI detail including TripAdvisor-style fields (ranking, price_level, suggested_duration_min, fun_fact). With auth, also returns is_favorited.

patch.description: Partial update of POI fields (provider or admin role). Re-indexes the POI in Qdrant after changes.

delete.description: Permanently delete a POI (provider or admin role). Removes it from the Qdrant index.

get.description: POIs in the same wilaya and category as the reference POI, filling from the same wilaya when needed.

schema.title: Response Get Pois Poi Id Similar

get.description: Plan an optimal walking route through a wilaya's POIs within a time budget, using the POI graph (walking times). Returns an ordered list of stops with walk/visit durations and cumulative time.
Density-based clustering of a wilaya's POIs by walking radius. Returns walkable clusters with their centers and representative POIs.
Top POIs by transit connectivity within a wilaya — the best starting points for public-transport exploration.
Personalized content-based recommendations (model cbf_v1) for the authenticated user, filtered by wilaya and entity type.
The user's inferred travel preferences (categories, budgets). Auto-creates a default profile on first access.

patch.description: Partially update the user's travel preferences.

post.description: Rebuild the user's preferences from their interaction history (favorites, collections, trips).
Record feedback on a recommendation: liked, dismissed, or bookmarked. Dismissed hides it; liked/bookmarked marks it seen.

get.description: Return the authenticated user's profile, including role, verification status, and provider profile link.

put.description: Update the authenticated user's profile fields. Role changes must use PUT /users/me/role.

Self-assign a role. Restricted to SELF_ASSIGNABLE_ROLES (traveler/guide/agency/hotel); the `admin` role cannot be self-assigned. Switching to a provider role auto-creates a provider profile, and switching away deletes it.
Update the authenticated user's provider profile (company name, website, experience, team size, etc.). The user must already have a provider role.

400.description: No provider profile — set your role to a provider type first

get.description: List all provider users (guide/agency/hotel) with their profiles. Public.
Return a single provider user with their profile. Public.
Aggregated dashboard for providers: listing counts (experiences/stays), active counts, and top 5 of each. Requires a provider role or admin.
All 69 wilayas with French/Arabic/English names and destination descriptions. Optional name search. Public.
Single wilaya detail including description and coordinates. Public.

post.description: Add a bookable tour/activity. Requires a provider role (guide, agency, or hotel). Indexed for vector search on creation.

get.description: Paginated experiences (active by default). Filters: wilaya, category, provider_id, season, provider_type, status.
Vector search over active experiences with PostgreSQL full-text (French) fallback when Qdrant is unavailable.
Experience detail plus provider info (name, avatar, role). With auth, also returns is_favorited.

put.description: Update an experience. Only the owning provider or an admin can edit. Re-indexes in Qdrant.

403.description: You can only edit your own experiences

delete.description: Delete an experience. Only the owning provider or an admin can delete. Removes from the Qdrant index.

403.description: You can only delete your own experiences

post.description: Append one or more photos (multipart, JPEG/PNG/WebP) to an experience's gallery via MinIO. Owner or admin only.

403.description: You can only edit your own experiences

post.description: List accommodation on the platform. Requires the authenticated user to have the hotel, agency, or admin role.

403.description: Only hotels and agencies can list stays

get.description: Paginated active stays filtered by wilaya, property type, and price range (DZD). Responses include provider name/avatar.
Stay detail with provider info. With auth, also returns is_favorited.

put.description: Update a stay listing. Only the owning provider or an admin can edit.

delete.description: Delete a stay listing. Only the owning provider or an admin can delete.

get.description: List reachable wilayas from an origin with driving distance/time, ordered by distance.

schema.title: Response Get Transport Routes From Origin Wilaya Id

get.description: Multi-modal options (train, bus, taxi, flight) between two wilayas with schedules, pricing, transfers, and operator contacts. Falls back to driving estimates when no scheduled line exists.

schema.title: Response Get Transport Routes Origin Wilaya Id Dest Wilaya Id

get.description: All transit stations, optionally filtered by wilaya and type (bus, train, tram, taxi, airport, ferry, cablecar).
Stations nearest to a lat/lng point, optionally filtered by type. Uses the transit graph spatial index.
Transport lines, optionally filtered by mode (bus, train, tram, taxi, flight, ferry, cablecar, walking). Includes schedules and pricing.

Multi-modal route from a GPS point to a destination with turn-by-turn steps: walking, transit (schedule + pricing), and transfers as milestones for line changes. Handles walking-only and driving-recommended cases.
Nearest stations and routing summary for a POI, useful for the 'how to get there' panel.

schema.title: Response Get Transport Access Poi Id

get.description: Turn-by-turn transit directions from a GPS point to a specific POI. Returns the plan plus POI access info. Falls back to an error object when no route exists.

schema.title: Response Get Transport Route To Poi Poi Id

get.description: Turn-by-turn transit directions from a GPS point to a specific artisan workshop. Returns the plan plus the nearest-transit walking edges. Falls back to an error object when no route exists or the artisan has no coordinates.

schema.title: Response Get Transport Route To Artisan Artisan Id

get.description: Active transport operators with contact info (phone, website, email) and coverage, filtered by mode: train, flight, bus, taxi, tram, cablecar, ferry.

parameters.name: mode

schema.description: Filter by mode: train, flight, bus, taxi, tram, cablecar
schema.title: Mode

parameters.description: Filter by mode: train, flight, bus, taxi, tram, cablecar

post.description: Create a trip plan with title, wilaya, dates, and budget. Returns the full day-structured plan with cost/spend breakdown.

get.description: Paginated trips for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by status (active/archived). Each trip includes day plans.
Generated travel brief for a wilaya: must-see POIs, suggested itinerary, budget guidance. Public.
Trip detail with enriched day plans (item details, gaps detected, per-day distance and cost, budget remaining). Owner only.

put.description: Update trip metadata (title, dates, budget, status). Owner only.

delete.description: Delete a trip and all of its items. Owner only.

post.description: Add a POI/experience/stay/restaurant/transport item to a day of the trip. POI items validate the POI exists. Auto-assigns the next sort order.

put.description: Change a trip item's day, sort order, or time slot. Owner only.

404.description: Trip or trip item not found

delete.description: Remove an item from a trip and return the updated trip. Owner only.

404.description: Trip or trip item not found

post.description: Generate (or reuse) an unguessable share token and a public share URL for the trip. Owner only.

get.description: View a trip by its public share token without authentication.

post.description: Reorder each day's items to minimize walking distance using the POI graph, then return the optimized trip. Owner only.

get.description: Fast prefix autocomplete across POI names, experience titles, and stay names. Sorted by name length.

Full-text search (French tsvector) across POIs, stays, and experiences in a single ranked result set. Each result carries entity_type, category, coordinates, price, and ts_rank score. Falls back gracefully if search vectors are absent.
All geolocated POIs as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of points, filtered by wilaya, category, or featured status.
All geolocated stays as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, filtered by wilaya. Each feature carries the primary photo URL.
Active experiences with a meeting point as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, filtered by wilaya or category.
POIs within a radius (haversine-filtered) returned as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with distance_km per feature.
The authenticated user's collections with item counts, newest first.

post.description: Create a named wishlist/trip collection, optionally public and with a description.

get.description: A collection with all its items (sorted by sort_order then created_at). Owner only.

put.description: Update a collection's name, description, or is_public flag. Owner only.

delete.description: Delete a collection and all of its items. Owner only.

post.description: Batch-add items to a collection. Duplicates (same entity_type + entity_id) are skipped. At least one item required.

schema.title: Response Post Collections Collection Id Items

delete.summary: Remove an item from a collection
delete.description: Remove a single item from a collection. Owner only.

post.description: Favorite an entity (poi, experience, or stay) by entity_type + entity_id. Returns 404-style error if already favorited.

get.description: The authenticated user's favorites, newest first. Optionally filtered by entity_type.

delete.description: Unfavorite an entity. Only the owning user can remove.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when the reply came from the offline rule-based fallback

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when the reply came from the offline rule-based fallback

ArtisanTransitAccessRead.description: A walking edge from an artisan to one nearby transit station.

ExperienceDetail.title: ExperienceDetail
ExperienceDetail.description: Experience + provider info for the detail view.

POIBrief.title: POIBrief
POIBrief.description: Lightweight POI for list/similar/nearby endpoints — no reviews.

ProviderUserRead.title: ProviderUserRead
ProviderUserRead.description: Public view of a provider — safe to expose to travelers.

tags.description: AI travel agents with multi-turn memory.
